turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: You're using the voice marketplace feature to let creators publish custom voices — how's adoption been?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Way better than expected. Creators love being able to monetize their cloned voice, and the revenue split terms were clear from day one, no disputes so far.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Any friction in that marketplace flow?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: The voice review/approval queue before a voice goes public can take up to 5 days, which frustrates creators who want to publish quickly after cloning.
